title: Sum of Beautiful Subsequences
summary: Given an integer array nums, calculate the sum of beauty values for all positive integers g, where the beauty of g is the product of g and the count of strictly increasing subsequences of nums with a greatest common divisor of exactly g.
statement: Given an integer array nums, calculate the sum of beauty values for all positive integers g, where the beauty of g is the product of g and the count of strictly increasing subsequences of nums with a greatest common divisor of exactly g. Return the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Up to 10,000 positive values no greater than 70,000.
Count every nonempty strictly increasing subsequence by indices.
target_time_complexity: O(sum tau(nums[i]) log n + V log log V)
hints: For every g, g equals the sum of phi(d) over divisors d of g.
Count increasing subsequences whose every value is divisible by each d, then weight by phi(d).
Bucket values by their divisors; within each bucket use a Fenwick tree over values to count strict increasing subsequences.
Each subsequence enters exactly the buckets dividing its GCD, whose phi weights sum back to that GCD.
editorial: Each subsequence enters exactly the buckets dividing its GCD, whose phi weights sum back to that GCD.

tests.explanation: The GCD contributions of all increasing subsequences sum to ten.
All seven nonempty subsequences are increasing and contribute total twelve.
